Nina (CS): Heads-up: Windfall hitting lots of 429s during initial embed SDK ramp. They launch ~40 workers on tab open. Short log: 'preflight 429 rate_limited route=/v1/preflight region=eu-central-1'.
Windfall Eng: Yep, repro steps: each worker immediately calls /auth/ephemeral then sdk.preflight(). Using embed-js v0.8.0. Happens in staging when we open the app.
Rex (Solutions): Okay — common pattern. Are they requesting a fresh ephemeral per worker?
Windfall Eng: Yes — we thought one-per-worker = isolated sessions.
Tara (OnboardEng): Isolation is fine but creates a preflight stampede. Quick mitigation: (1) reuse ephemeral tokens for a short window (e.g., 15-30s), (2) enable sdk.preflightCoalesce flag, (3) add startup splay (100-600ms) and batch workers into groups of 4-8.
Omar (SRE): Also verify key scope. If they're using an restricted service key it may be on a tighter rate limiter. Confirm X-SDK-Version and X-Client-Region headers in traces.
Windfall Eng: Headers: X-SDK-Version: 0.8.0, X-Client-Region: eu-central-1. We'll try Tara's changes.
ci-bot: CI job started: cs/docs/add-windfall-playbook -> creating branch.
Windfall Eng: Quick smoke: switched to token reuse 20s, preflightCoalesce=true, splay 100-600ms, batched 8 at a time. Ran 200 concurrent warmup attempts: 2 preflight 429s (down from ~30). So much better.
Rex (Solutions): For retries use exponential backoff with full jitter. Example: base=150ms, cap=5s, jitter=random(0, base*2**attempt). Also set client-side debounce on preflight to 500ms.
Windfall Eng: Applied debounce 500ms + retry backoff. Longer soak underway.
Tara (OnboardEng): I'll add a short checklist to onboarding notes: Symptoms -> Cause -> Fixes (reuse window, coalesce, splay, batch, backoff). Can someone open a quick docs PR for the SDK quickstart defaults?
Nina (CS): I'll coordinate with the customer and mark as onboarding risk until the soak completes. Please paste exact snippets in the PR so Windfall can copy-paste.
Windfall Eng: Soak 45m passed, 0 new 429s. Thanks all! We'll push the init change to prod. :party_popper:
Nina (CS): Great outcome. I'll follow up on renewal health after production ramp.
